Name: Custom TV Channel
Author: shghc03
Description:
[b]This mod allows you to add channels to your TV in Stardew Valley[/b]


[b][i] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[size=5]If you want to know how to create a content pack, you can download the sample content pack in the optional file[/size][/i][/b][size=5]

[/size][size=3]
[/size][b][size=3]manifest.json[/size]
[/b]
[code]﻿{
    "Name": "Your Mod Name",
    "Author": "Your Name",
    "Version": "1.0.0",
    "Description": "One or two sentences about the mod.",
    "UniqueID": "YourName.YourModName",
    "UpdateKeys": [],
    "ContentPackFor": {
        "UniqueID": "chieeri323.customtvchannel"
    }
}
[/code]﻿
[size=3]


[b]content.json（Examples）[/b][/size]
[code]{
  "channelInfos": [
 {
"Channelkey": "testchannel2",
"ChannelName": "xxx channel",
"ChannelDescription": "Welcome to xxx TV channel",
"ShowDays":"Mon",
"ChannelType":{
﻿"currentChannel": 10,
﻿"ScreenFile":"assets/Mod_Namescreen.png",
﻿"animation":{
﻿"AnimationInterval": 150,
﻿"AnimationLength":2
﻿ },
﻿ "ad":{
﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿"RandomQuestion":{
﻿ "10101":{"ADPrice":9999,"ItemID":["(O)373"],"QuestionText":"Do you want to buy A pumpkin? Only<>G!"},
﻿ "2233":{"ADPrice":9999,"ItemID":["(O)373"],"QuestionText":"Do you want to buy A pumpkin? Only<>G"}
﻿},
﻿"Select1" : "Yeeeees!",
﻿"Select2" : "NO."
﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿}

﻿}
}
  ]
}
[/code]
[b]Tips:
[/b]
﻿All channels are rebroadcast every two years，In the fields Tips and Question, 1 and 8 represent the days of the year (Stardew Valley has 112 days in a year).
﻿If the ScreenFile and Animation are not set, the default image is used.

[b][size=3]Possible fields:
[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]ChannelName : [/b][i]The name of the channel displayed when watching TV[/i]
[*][b]ChannelDescription:[/b] [i]The contents of the dialog box when selecting a TV channel[/i]
[*][b]ShowDays: [/b][i]The date on which the weekly channel is displayed in the game[/i]
[*][b]ChannelType.[/b]﻿[b]currentChannel :[/b][i] Must be set, cannot be 2,3,4,5,6,666,9999, in order not to conflict with other content packages, use a number as the prefix (e.g. 2427801,2427802).[/i]
[*][b][b]ChannelType.[/b]ScreenFile :[/b][i] If there is an animation for the channel, this is the relative path of the image[/i]
[*][b][b]ChannelType.[/b]animation: [/b][i]Sets the length and interval of the animation[/i]
[*][b]ChannelType.normal: [/b][i]A type of TV channel[/i]
[*][i][b]ChannelType.normal[/b][/i][b].[/b][b]Tips[/b][i][b]：[/b]The content to display after selecting the channel, where the key is the game date (maximum value 224) and the value is the display text[b][/b][/i]

[*][b]ChannelType.[/b][b]ad: [/b][i]A type of TV channel[/i]
[*][b]ChannelType.ad.Question:[/b][i]After selecting the channel, the problem dialog box displayed in the game, the key is the game date, the maximum is 224 (because it will be replayed every two years).[/i]
[*][b]ChannelType.ad.RandomQuestion:[/b][i]When RandomQuestion is used instead of Question, a random dictionary is selected for the date displayed on the channel[/i]
[*][b]Select1,2[/b][i][b] :The display name of the two options in the problem dialog box[/b][/i]

[/list]
[b][size=4]Plans for future updates：

[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Add new channel types and let players add new recipes
[*]Add new channel types that allow players to receive quests via TV

[/list]
